cohort: 826 syphilis-exposed but uninfected (SEU) infants and 1,652 syphilis-unexposed uninfected (SUU) infants from the China PMTCT program in Suzhou (2016-2021)
finding: SEU infants exhibited non-inferior growth patterns in weight, length, and BMI z-score during their first 18 months of life compared to SUU controls.
mod_finding: This study found that infants exposed to syphilis but uninfected had slightly higher length and weight at some time points compared to syphilis-unexposed infants, even after adjusting for mode of delivery.
